title: spermacoce distans
intro: Spermacoce distans, commonly known as Phyllangia or Phyllangium, is a species of flowering plant in the Rubiaceae family. It is known for its various health benefits, including its use in treating digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce distans include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
